notes: Shared defaults. mode: off | shadow (log only) | recheck. policy: stable-disagreement (default; flag a finding only when the severity question, asked k times with the option order shuffled, gives the same label every time AND it differs from Claude AND it crosses the merge boundary; upward first, max 3 per PR; no threshold needed) | threshold (old policy: differs and top probability >= threshold, which must be calibrated with laya-eval.mjs; recheck without it runs as shadow). stabilityScope: all (sample every finding) | boundary (sample only findings whose first answer already crosses the merge boundary; cheaper, may miss a stable answer that differs from the first). questions: the extra yes/no questions introduced_by_pr and already_raised (log only; need the PR JSON next to the findings file). Per-machine overrides go to laya.local.json (gitignored). Env wins: XT_REVIEW_PR_LAYA, XT_REVIEW_PR_LAYA_POLICY, XT_REVIEW_PR_LAYA_K, XT_REVIEW_PR_LAYA_THRESHOLD, LAYA_URL. mergeBlockThreshold: block the PR when Laya's P(Blocked) >= this (env XT_REVIEW_PR_LAYA_MERGE_BLOCK); chosen on 3 sets x 16 severity combinations, checked on a 4th. provider: laya (default) | jev (TypeSafe Jev via OpenRouter, needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment, never stored here); env XT_REVIEW_PR_DECIDER or DECISION_PROVIDER wins, --provider wins over both.
